title: Estimating the Individualized Effect of Tooth Extraction before Radiotherapy on Osteoradionecrosis Using Causal Machine Learning
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Volume 105, Issue 12, Page 1564-1573, November 2026.
The purpose of this study was to determine the average treatment effect (ATE) of tooth extraction before radiotherapy on the risk of osteoradionecrosis (ORN) in patients with head and neck cancer (HNC) and to estimate the conditional average treatment ...
